Asset: EUV lithography tool bay (Line 3) — scanner control network and tool parameter recipes
Vulnerability: Scanner recipes and tool parameter sets are stored on a shared SMB file share with no access logging; the file share is reachable from the office VLAN
Likelihood (1-5) + reason: 4 — a phishing email to a process engineer is close to routine
Impact (1-5) + reason: and the recipe share has no authentication logs to review afterward
Inherent Risk (L x I): 5 — a modified exposure recipe can scrap a full lot of wafers and hold the line for weeks; the exposure parameters are also the fab's most valuable IP
Residual Risk (L x I) + axis changed + l: Isolate the tool parameter share onto the process OT segment behind a firewall rule; migrate recipes to a version-controlled store with per-tool ACLs and access logging. NT$1,200,000, OT engineering + fab IT, 10 weeks
Owner: 10 — likelihood drops to 2 because the share is no longer reachable from the office VLAN; impact stays 5 because a privileged process engineer can still alter recipes. The control limits lateral reach
column9: it does not stop a determined insider

Impact (1-5) + reason: so any one of 7 people can open the dock

Owner: or precursors; a mis-delivery of chemicals is a safety event as well as a loss event
